CREATE TRIGGER trg_knockout_advancement AFTER UPDATE OF status, result_status, winner_team_id ON matches FOR EACH ROW WHEN (new.stage = ANY (ARRAY['SEMIFINAL'::text, 'FINAL'::text])) EXECUTE FUNCTION handle_knockout_advancement()

functions.name: is_super_admin

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_super_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    select exists (
        select 1
        from public.user_roles ur
        where ur.user_id = auth.uid()
          and ur.role = 'SUPER_ADMIN'
          and ur.status = 'ACTIVE'
    );
$function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    select
        public.is_super_admin()
        or exists (
            select 1
            from public.user_roles ur
            where ur.user_id = auth.uid()
              and ur.organization_id = p_organization_id
              and ur.role = 'ORGANIZER'
              and ur.status = 'ACTIVE'
        );
$function$

functions.name: can_manage_event

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_manage_event(p_event_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    select
        public.is_super_admin()
        or exists (
            select 1
            from public.events e
            join public.user_roles ur
              on ur.organization_id = e.organization_id
            where e.id = p_event_id
              and ur.user_id = auth.uid()
              and ur.role = 'ORGANIZER'
              and ur.status = 'ACTIVE'
        );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_team_captain(p_team_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    select
        public.is_super_admin()
        or exists (
            select 1
            from public.teams t
            where t.id = p_team_id
              and t.captain_user_id = auth.uid()
        )
        or exists (
            select 1
            from public.user_roles ur
            where ur.user_id = auth.uid()
              and ur.team_id = p_team_id
              and ur.role = 'CAPTAIN'
              and ur.status = 'ACTIVE'
        );
$function$

functions.name: handle_new_user
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin

    insert into public.profiles (
        id,
        first_name,
        last_name
    )
    values (
        new.id,
        new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'first_name',
        new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'last_name'
    )
    on conflict (id) do nothing;

    return new;

end;
$function$

functions.name: validate_match_schedule
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_match_schedule()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
    minimum_rest interval := interval '60 minutes';
begin

    if new.scheduled_start is null
       or new.scheduled_end is null then
        return new;
    end if;


    if new.scheduled_end <= new.scheduled_start then
        raise exception
            'Match scheduled_end must be after scheduled_start';
    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- PLAYING AREA CONFLICT
    -- ========================================================

    if new.playing_area_id is not null
       and exists (
            select 1
            from public.matches m
            where m.id <> new.id
              and m.playing_area_id = new.playing_area_id
              and m.status not in ('CANCELLED', 'POSTPONED')
              and m.scheduled_start is not null
              and m.scheduled_end is not null
              and new.scheduled_start < m.scheduled_end
              and new.scheduled_end > m.scheduled_start
       )
    then
        raise exception
            'Scheduling conflict: playing area is already booked during this time';
    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- HOME TEAM REST / OVERLAP CHECK
    -- ========================================================

    if new.home_team_id is not null
       and exists (
            select 1
            from public.matches m
            where m.id <> new.id
              and m.status not in ('CANCELLED', 'POSTPONED')
              and m.scheduled_start is not null
              and m.scheduled_end is not null

              and (
                    m.home_team_id = new.home_team_id
                    or
                    m.away_team_id = new.home_team_id
              )

              and new.scheduled_start
                    < m.scheduled_end + minimum_rest

              and new.scheduled_end
                    > m.scheduled_start - minimum_rest
       )
    then
        raise exception
            'Scheduling conflict: home team does not have the required 60-minute rest period';
    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- AWAY TEAM REST / OVERLAP CHECK
    -- ========================================================

    if new.away_team_id is not null
       and exists (
            select 1
            from public.matches m
            where m.id <> new.id
              and m.status not in ('CANCELLED', 'POSTPONED')
              and m.scheduled_start is not null
              and m.scheduled_end is not null

              and (
                    m.home_team_id = new.away_team_id
                    or
                    m.away_team_id = new.away_team_id
              )

              and new.scheduled_start
                    < m.scheduled_end + minimum_rest

              and new.scheduled_end
                    > m.scheduled_start - minimum_rest
       )
    then
        raise exception
            'Scheduling conflict: away team does not have the required 60-minute rest period';
    end if;


    return new;

end;
$function$

functions.name: recalculate_cricket_standings
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recalculate_cricket_standings(p_group_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin

    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- Reset current standings
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    update public.standings
    set
        played = 0,
        won = 0,
        lost = 0,
        tied = 0,
        no_result = 0,
        points = 0,

        runs_for = 0,
        balls_faced = 0,

        runs_against = 0,
        balls_bowled = 0,

        net_run_rate = 0,
        rank = null,

        updated_at = now()

    where group_id = p_group_id;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- Rebuild standings from CONFIRMED results
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    with completed_matches as (

        select
            m.id as match_id,
            m.home_team_id,
            m.away_team_id,

            mr.result_type,
            mr.winner_team_id,
            mr.loser_team_id

        from public.matches m

        join public.match_results mr
            on mr.match_id = m.id

        where m.group_id = p_group_id
          and m.stage = 'GROUP'
          and m.status = 'COMPLETED'
          and mr.verified = true
    ),

    team_results as (

        -- HOME TEAM VIEW
        select
            cm.match_id,
            cm.home_team_id as team_id,

            case
                when cm.result_type in ('WIN', 'FORFEIT', 'WALKOVER')
                     and cm.winner_team_id = cm.home_team_id
                    then 1
                else 0
            end as won,

            case
                when cm.result_type in ('WIN', 'FORFEIT', 'WALKOVER')
                     and cm.loser_team_id = cm.home_team_id
                    then 1
                else 0
            end as lost,

            case
                when cm.result_type = 'TIE'
                    then 1
                else 0
            end as tied,

            case
                when cm.result_type = 'NO_RESULT'
                    then 1
                else 0
            end as no_result

        from completed_matches cm

        union all

        -- AWAY TEAM VIEW
        select
            cm.match_id,
            cm.away_team_id,

            case
                when cm.result_type in ('WIN', 'FORFEIT', 'WALKOVER')
                     and cm.winner_team_id = cm.away_team_id
                    then 1
                else 0
            end,

            case
                when cm.result_type in ('WIN', 'FORFEIT', 'WALKOVER')
                     and cm.loser_team_id = cm.away_team_id
                    then 1
                else 0
            end,

            case
                when cm.result_type = 'TIE'
                    then 1
                else 0
            end,

            case
                when cm.result_type = 'NO_RESULT'
                    then 1
                else 0
            end

        from completed_matches cm
    ),

    aggregated_results as (

        select
            team_id,

            count(*) as played,

            sum(won) as won,
            sum(lost) as lost,
            sum(tied) as tied,
            sum(no_result) as no_result,

            (
                sum(won) * 2
                +
                sum(tied)
                +
                sum(no_result)
            )::numeric as points

        from team_results

        group by team_id
    )

    update public.standings s

    set
        played = ar.played,
        won = ar.won,
        lost = ar.lost,
        tied = ar.tied,
        no_result = ar.no_result,
        points = ar.points,
        updated_at = now()

    from aggregated_results ar

    where s.group_id = p_group_id
      and s.team_id = ar.team_id;


    -- ========================================================
    -- 2. CALCULATE CRICKET RUN / BALL TOTALS
    --
    -- NRR uses:
    --
    -- runs scored / overs faced
    -- MINUS
    -- runs conceded / overs bowled
    --
    -- We store balls, therefore:
    --
    -- run rate = runs * 6 / balls
    -- ========================================================

    with valid_matches as (

        select m.id

        from public.matches m

        join public.match_results mr
            on mr.match_id = m.id

        where m.group_id = p_group_id
          and m.stage = 'GROUP'
          and m.status = 'COMPLETED'
          and mr.verified = true

          -- Only innings-based results affect NRR
          and mr.result_type in ('WIN', 'TIE')
    ),

    batting_totals as (

        select
            ci.team_id,

            sum(ci.runs) as runs_for,

            sum(
                case
                    when ci.all_out = true
                        then ci.max_balls
                    else ci.balls_faced
                end
            ) as balls_faced

        from public.cricket_innings ci

        join valid_matches vm
            on vm.id = ci.match_id

        group by ci.team_id
    ),

    bowling_totals as (

        select
            opponent.team_id,

            sum(ci.runs) as runs_against,

            sum(
                case
                    when ci.all_out = true
                        then ci.max_balls
                    else ci.balls_faced
                end
            ) as balls_bowled

        from public.cricket_innings ci

        join valid_matches vm
            on vm.id = ci.match_id

        join public.matches m
            on m.id = ci.match_id

        cross join lateral (

            select
                case
                    when ci.team_id = m.home_team_id
                        then m.away_team_id
                    else m.home_team_id
                end as team_id

        ) opponent

        group by opponent.team_id
    )

    update public.standings s

    set
        runs_for =
            coalesce(bt.runs_for, 0),

        balls_faced =
            coalesce(bt.balls_faced, 0),

        runs_against =
            coalesce(bwt.runs_against, 0),

        balls_bowled =
            coalesce(bwt.balls_bowled, 0),

        net_run_rate =
            case

                when coalesce(bt.balls_faced, 0) > 0
                 and coalesce(bwt.balls_bowled, 0) > 0

                then round(

                    (
                        (
                            bt.runs_for::numeric * 6
                            /
                            bt.balls_faced
                        )

                        -

                        (
                            bwt.runs_against::numeric * 6
                            /
                            bwt.balls_bowled
                        )

                    ),

                    4
                )

                else 0

            end,

        updated_at = now()

    from batting_totals bt

    join bowling_totals bwt
        on bwt.team_id = bt.team_id

    where s.group_id = p_group_id
      and s.team_id = bt.team_id;


    -- ========================================================
    -- 3. RANK GROUP
    --
    -- V1:
    -- 1. Points
    -- 2. Net Run Rate
    -- 3. Wins
    -- 4. Team name (deterministic fallback)
    --
    -- Head-to-head can be added later.
    -- ========================================================

    with ranked as (

        select
            s.id,

            row_number() over (

                order by
                    s.points desc,
                    s.net_run_rate desc,
                    s.won desc,
                    t.team_name asc

            ) as calculated_rank

        from public.standings s

        join public.teams t
            on t.id = s.team_id

        where s.group_id = p_group_id
    )

    update public.standings s

    set
        rank = r.calculated_rank,
        updated_at = now()

    from ranked r

    where s.id = r.id;

end;
$function$

functions.name: record_cricket_result
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_cricket_result(p_match_id uuid, p_home_runs integer, p_home_wickets integer, p_home_balls integer, p_away_runs integer, p_away_wickets integer, p_away_balls integer, p_max_balls integer DEFAULT 48)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

declare

    v_match public.matches%rowtype;

    v_winner uuid;
    v_loser uuid;

    v_result_type text;
    v_result_summary text;

begin

    -- ========================================================
    -- LOAD MATCH
    -- ========================================================

    select *
    into v_match

    from public.matches

    where id = p_match_id;


    if not found then
        raise exception 'Match not found';
    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- AUTHORIZATION
    -- ========================================================

    if not public.can_manage_event(v_match.event_id) then
        raise exception
            'Not authorized to record this match result';
    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- SUPPORTED CRICKET STAGES
    -- ========================================================

    if v_match.stage not in (
        'GROUP',
        'SEMIFINAL',
        'FINAL',
        'THIRD_PLACE'
    ) then

        raise exception
            'Cricket result entry is not supported for stage %',
            v_match.stage;

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- VALIDATE TEAMS
    -- ========================================================

    if v_match.home_team_id is null
       or v_match.away_team_id is null then

        raise exception
            'Match participants have not been resolved';

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- VALIDATE SCORE
    -- ========================================================

    if p_home_runs < 0
       or p_away_runs < 0 then

        raise exception 'Runs cannot be negative';

    end if;


    if p_home_wickets < 0
       or p_home_wickets > 10
       or p_away_wickets < 0
       or p_away_wickets > 10 then

        raise exception
            'Wickets must be between 0 and 10';

    end if;


    if p_home_balls <= 0
       or p_away_balls <= 0
       or p_max_balls <= 0 then

        raise exception
            'Ball counts must be greater than zero';

    end if;


    if p_home_balls > p_max_balls
       or p_away_balls > p_max_balls then

        raise exception
            'Balls faced cannot exceed maximum balls';

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- DETERMINE RESULT
    -- ========================================================

    if p_home_runs > p_away_runs then

        v_winner := v_match.home_team_id;
        v_loser  := v_match.away_team_id;

        v_result_type := 'WIN';

        v_result_summary :=
            format(
                'Home team won by %s runs',
                p_home_runs - p_away_runs
            );


    elsif p_away_runs > p_home_runs then

        v_winner := v_match.away_team_id;
        v_loser  := v_match.home_team_id;

        v_result_type := 'WIN';

        v_result_summary :=
            format(
                'Away team won with %s wickets remaining',
                10 - p_away_wickets
            );


    else

        -- Knockout cricket must produce a winner.
        -- Super-over / tie-break support will be added later.

        if v_match.stage <> 'GROUP' then

            raise exception
                'Knockout match cannot end in an unresolved tie';

        end if;

        v_winner := null;
        v_loser  := null;

        v_result_type := 'TIE';
        v_result_summary := 'Match tied';

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- HOME INNINGS
    -- ========================================================

    insert into public.cricket_innings (
        match_id,
        team_id,
        innings_number,
        runs,
        wickets,
        balls_faced,
        max_balls,
        all_out
    )

    values (
        p_match_id,
        v_match.home_team_id,
        1,
        p_home_runs,
        p_home_wickets,
        p_home_balls,
        p_max_balls,
        p_home_wickets = 10
    )

    on conflict (match_id, innings_number)

    do update set

        team_id = excluded.team_id,
        runs = excluded.runs,
        wickets = excluded.wickets,
        balls_faced = excluded.balls_faced,
        max_balls = excluded.max_balls,
        all_out = excluded.all_out,
        updated_at = now();


    -- ========================================================
    -- AWAY INNINGS
    -- ========================================================

    insert into public.cricket_innings (
        match_id,
        team_id,
        innings_number,
        runs,
        wickets,
        balls_faced,
        max_balls,
        all_out
    )

    values (
        p_match_id,
        v_match.away_team_id,
        2,
        p_away_runs,
        p_away_wickets,
        p_away_balls,
        p_max_balls,
        p_away_wickets = 10
    )

    on conflict (match_id, innings_number)

    do update set

        team_id = excluded.team_id,
        runs = excluded.runs,
        wickets = excluded.wickets,
        balls_faced = excluded.balls_faced,
        max_balls = excluded.max_balls,
        all_out = excluded.all_out,
        updated_at = now();


    -- ========================================================
    -- MATCH RESULT
    -- ========================================================

    insert into public.match_results (
        match_id,
        winner_team_id,
        loser_team_id,
        result_type,
        result_summary,
        home_points,
        away_points,
        verified,
        verified_by,
        verified_at
    )

    values (
        p_match_id,
        v_winner,
        v_loser,
        v_result_type,
        v_result_summary,
        p_home_runs,
        p_away_runs,
        true,
        auth.uid(),
        now()
    )

    on conflict (match_id)

    do update set

        winner_team_id = excluded.winner_team_id,
        loser_team_id = excluded.loser_team_id,
        result_type = excluded.result_type,
        result_summary = excluded.result_summary,
        home_points = excluded.home_points,
        away_points = excluded.away_points,
        verified = true,
        verified_by = auth.uid(),
        verified_at = now(),
        updated_at = now();


    -- ========================================================
    -- COMPLETE MATCH
    -- ========================================================

    update public.matches

    set
        status = 'COMPLETED',
        result_status = 'CONFIRMED',
        winner_team_id = v_winner,
        actual_end = now(),
        updated_at = now()

    where id = p_match_id;


    -- ========================================================
    -- GROUP STANDINGS ONLY
    -- ========================================================

    if v_match.stage = 'GROUP'
       and v_match.group_id is not null then

        perform public.recalculate_cricket_standings(
            v_match.group_id
        );

    end if;

end;

$function$
functions.identity_args: p_match_id uuid, p_home_runs integer, p_home_wickets integer, p_home_balls integer, p_away_runs integer, p_away_wickets integer, p_away_balls integer, p_max_balls integer

functions.name: resolve_semifinalists
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_semifinalists(p_event_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

declare

    v_group_a uuid;
    v_group_b uuid;

    v_a1 uuid;
    v_a2 uuid;

    v_b1 uuid;
    v_b2 uuid;

    v_sf1 uuid;
    v_sf2 uuid;

    v_incomplete_count integer;

begin

    -- ========================================================
    -- AUTHORIZATION
    -- ========================================================

    if not public.can_manage_event(p_event_id) then
        raise exception
            'Not authorized to resolve semifinalists';
    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- FIND GROUPS
    -- ========================================================

    select g.id
    into v_group_a

    from public.groups g

    join public.divisions d
        on d.id = g.division_id

    where d.event_id = p_event_id
      and g.name = 'Group A';


    select g.id
    into v_group_b

    from public.groups g

    join public.divisions d
        on d.id = g.division_id

    where d.event_id = p_event_id
      and g.name = 'Group B';


    if v_group_a is null
       or v_group_b is null then

        raise exception
            'Group A or Group B not found';

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- VERIFY ALL GROUP MATCHES ARE COMPLETED
    -- ========================================================

    select count(*)
    into v_incomplete_count

    from public.matches m

    where m.event_id = p_event_id
      and m.stage = 'GROUP'

      and (
            m.status <> 'COMPLETED'
            or
            m.result_status <> 'CONFIRMED'
          );


    if v_incomplete_count > 0 then

        raise exception
            'Cannot resolve semifinalists: % group matches are incomplete',
            v_incomplete_count;

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- GET GROUP A #1 AND #2
    -- ========================================================

    select s.team_id
    into v_a1

    from public.standings s

    where s.group_id = v_group_a
      and s.rank = 1;


    select s.team_id
    into v_a2

    from public.standings s

    where s.group_id = v_group_a
      and s.rank = 2;


    -- ========================================================
    -- GET GROUP B #1 AND #2
    -- ========================================================

    select s.team_id
    into v_b1

    from public.standings s

    where s.group_id = v_group_b
      and s.rank = 1;


    select s.team_id
    into v_b2

    from public.standings s

    where s.group_id = v_group_b
      and s.rank = 2;


    if v_a1 is null
       or v_a2 is null
       or v_b1 is null
       or v_b2 is null then

        raise exception
            'Final group rankings are incomplete';

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- FIND SEMIFINAL MATCHES
    -- ========================================================

    select id
    into v_sf1

    from public.matches

    where event_id = p_event_id
      and match_code = 'SF1';


    select id
    into v_sf2

    from public.matches

    where event_id = p_event_id
      and match_code = 'SF2';


    if v_sf1 is null
       or v_sf2 is null then

        raise exception
            'Semifinal fixtures not found';

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- RESOLVE SF1
    --
    -- A1 vs B2
    -- ========================================================

    update public.matches

    set
        home_team_id = v_a1,
        away_team_id = v_b2,

        status = 'DRAFT',

        result_status = 'PENDING',

        updated_at = now()

    where id = v_sf1;


    -- ========================================================
    -- RESOLVE SF2

end;

functions.name: resolve_finalists
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_finalists(p_event_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

declare

    v_sf1_id uuid;
    v_sf2_id uuid;
    v_final_id uuid;

    v_sf1_winner uuid;
    v_sf2_winner uuid;

begin

    -- ========================================================
    -- AUTHORIZATION
    -- ========================================================

    if not public.can_manage_event(p_event_id) then
        raise exception
            'Not authorized to resolve finalists';
    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- FIND SF1
    -- ========================================================

    select
        id,
        winner_team_id

    into
        v_sf1_id,
        v_sf1_winner

    from public.matches

    where event_id = p_event_id
      and match_code = 'SF1'
      and stage = 'SEMIFINAL';


    -- ========================================================
    -- FIND SF2
    -- ========================================================

    select
        id,
        winner_team_id

    into
        v_sf2_id,
        v_sf2_winner

    from public.matches

    where event_id = p_event_id
      and match_code = 'SF2'
      and stage = 'SEMIFINAL';


    if v_sf1_id is null
       or v_sf2_id is null then

        raise exception
            'Semifinal matches not found';

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- BOTH SEMIFINALS MUST BE COMPLETED
    -- ========================================================

    if not exists (
        select 1
        from public.matches
        where id = v_sf1_id
          and status = 'COMPLETED'
          and result_status = 'CONFIRMED'
    ) then

        raise exception
            'SF1 is not completed and confirmed';

    end if;


    if not exists (
        select 1
        from public.matches
        where id = v_sf2_id
          and status = 'COMPLETED'
          and result_status = 'CONFIRMED'
    ) then

        raise exception
            'SF2 is not completed and confirmed';

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- BOTH SEMIFINALS MUST HAVE WINNERS
    -- ========================================================

    if v_sf1_winner is null
       or v_sf2_winner is null then

        raise exception
            'Both semifinals must have a winner';

    end if;


    if v_sf1_winner = v_sf2_winner then

        raise exception
            'Invalid knockout state: same team won both semifinals';

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- FIND FINAL
    -- ========================================================

    select id
    into v_final_id

    from public.matches

    where event_id = p_event_id
      and match_code = 'FINAL'
      and stage = 'FINAL';


    if v_final_id is null then

        raise exception
            'Final match not found';

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- PROTECT AN ALREADY COMPLETED FINAL
    -- ========================================================

    if exists (
        select 1
        from public.matches
        where id = v_final_id
          and status = 'COMPLETED'
    ) then

        raise exception
            'Final is already completed';

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- RESOLVE FINAL
    --
    -- Home = SF1 winner
    -- Away = SF2 winner
    -- ========================================================

    update public.matches

    set
        home_team_id = v_sf1_winner,
        away_team_id = v_sf2_winner,

        home_source_type = 'MATCH_WINNER',
        home_source_ref = 'SF1',

        away_source_type = 'MATCH_WINNER',
        away_source_ref = 'SF2',

        status = 'DRAFT',
        result_status = 'PENDING',

        updated_at = now()

    where id = v_final_id;

end;

$function$

functions.name: handle_knockout_advancement
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_knockout_advancement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

declare
    v_sf_count integer;
    v_completed_sf_count integer;

begin

    -- Only process confirmed completed knockout matches.
    if new.status <> 'COMPLETED'
       or new.result_status <> 'CONFIRMED'
       or new.winner_team_id is null then

        return new;

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- SEMIFINAL ADVANCEMENT
    -- ========================================================

    if new.stage = 'SEMIFINAL' then

        -- Count semifinals belonging to this event.
        select count(*)
        into v_sf_count
        from public.matches
        where event_id = new.event_id
          and stage = 'SEMIFINAL';


        -- Count completed/confirmed semifinals with winners.
        select count(*)
        into v_completed_sf_count
        from public.matches
        where event_id = new.event_id
          and stage = 'SEMIFINAL'
          and status = 'COMPLETED'
          and result_status = 'CONFIRMED'
          and winner_team_id is not null;


        -- Only resolve the Final after ALL semifinals
        -- have produced confirmed winners.
        if v_sf_count > 0
           and v_sf_count = v_completed_sf_count then

            perform public.resolve_finalists(new.event_id);

        end if;

    end if;


    return new;

end;

$function$

functions.name: complete_tournament
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_tournament(p_event_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

declare

    v_final public.matches%rowtype;
    v_unfinished_matches integer;

begin

    -- ========================================================
    -- AUTHORIZATION
    -- ========================================================

    if not public.can_manage_event(p_event_id) then

        raise exception
            'Not authorized to complete this tournament';

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- FIND FINAL
    -- ========================================================

    select *
    into v_final

    from public.matches

    where event_id = p_event_id
      and stage = 'FINAL';


    if not found then

        raise exception
            'Tournament Final not found';

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- FINAL MUST BE COMPLETE
    -- ========================================================

    if v_final.status <> 'COMPLETED'
       or v_final.result_status <> 'CONFIRMED'
       or v_final.winner_team_id is null then

        raise exception
            'Tournament cannot be completed until the Final has a confirmed winner';

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- CHECK FOR UNFINISHED COMPETITION MATCHES
    -- ========================================================

    select count(*)
    into v_unfinished_matches

    from public.matches

    where event_id = p_event_id

      and stage in (
          'GROUP',
          'ROUND_OF_32',
          'ROUND_OF_16',
          'QUARTERFINAL',
          'SEMIFINAL',
          'FINAL',
          'THIRD_PLACE'
      )

      and status not in (
          'COMPLETED',
          'CANCELLED',
          'FORFEITED'
      );


    if v_unfinished_matches > 0 then

        raise exception
            'Tournament still has % unfinished competition matches',
            v_unfinished_matches;

    end if;


    -- ========================================================
    -- COMPLETE EVENT
    -- ========================================================

    update public.events

    set
        status = 'COMPLETED',
        updated_at = now()

    where id = p_event_id;

end;

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_event_staff(p_event_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

    select
        public.is_super_admin()

        or exists (

            select 1

            from public.event_staff_assignments esa

            where esa.event_id = p_event_id

              and esa.user_id = auth.uid()

              and esa.status in (
                  'ASSIGNED',
                  'CONFIRMED'
              )
        );
